products.name: Kitchorea
products.description: Kitchorea brings your restaurant's front of house, kitchen and back office together. Take orders by QR, waiter app or counter, push them instantly to the kitchen display, manage tables, track recipes and stock, and see your sales live from anywhere.

products.name: CampusOne
products.description: CampusOne manages admissions, attendance, fees, exams, timetables and parent communication in a single platform — with mobile apps for teachers and parents.

products.name: StockPilot
products.description: StockPilot tracks stock across stores and warehouses in real time, raises purchase orders automatically when items run low, and gives you barcode-driven receiving, transfers and audits.

products.name: PeopleHub
products.tagline: HR and payroll in one click.
products.description: PeopleHub handles onboarding, attendance, leave, and fully compliant payroll with PF, ESI, PT and TDS — and gives employees a self-service portal for payslips and requests.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get started?
faqs.a: Most businesses are live within 3–10 days, depending on data migration and the modules chosen.

faqs.q: Can the applications be customised for my business?
faqs.a: Yes. Every application can be configured, and we build custom modules and workflows on request.

faqs.q: Do you provide tax and accounting services separately?
faqs.a: Yes. Income tax filing, CA, GST, accounting, HR and payroll services are available on their own or bundled with our software.
Data is encrypted in transit, backed up daily and access is controlled by role.
